run_UvicornWorker: run a Gunicorn worker with Uvicorn to serve an ASGI application on configured sockets
build_UvicornH11Worker: build a Gunicorn worker subclass that uses the asyncio loop and h11 HTTP implementation for ASGI apps
configure_UvicornWorker_SSL: configure UvicornWorker with SSL options including keyfile, certfile, and cipher settings for secure connections
configure_UvicornWorker_logging: configure UvicornWorker to redirect uvicorn error and access log handlers to Gunicorn's logging system
handle_UvicornWorker_signals: handle Gunicorn and Uvicorn signals including SIGUSR1 for worker reload and SIGQUIT for graceful shutdown
